title: ClaimSourceMapSchema
description: Contract generated by Drafting Agent mapping technical claims to Stable Source IDs and final IEEE citation numbers

source_to_ieee_map.description: Mapping from Stable Source ID (SRC-xxx) to IEEE reference number [n] based on first appearance order in the final article

claims.description: Granular list of technical statements, quantitative thresholds, or formulas in the article

section_target.description: Article section where the claim appears (e.g., Section 2.1)

claim_text.description: The technical statement or quantitative threshold

source_ids.description: Associated Stable Source IDs from evidence.json

citation_required.description: Whether an in-text citation [n] at sentence end is required

locator_required.description: Whether a specific locator (page/table/section) must accompany the citation

locator_status.description: Locator verification status; only LOCATOR_VERIFIED permits specific page/table/section locators

assigned_ieee_numbers.description: Final IEEE citation numbers corresponding to source_ids in first appearance order
